header.title: From the source into the right folder
header.description: Storage roots form the path allowlist. Categories only add relative targets; rules are evaluated strictly in ascending priority.

backup.invalid_file: The selected file is not an rDownloader routing bundle
backup.confirm_description: The file contains {categories} categories and {rules} rules. Existing entries with the same name are kept; only new ones are added.

root.title: Storage roots
root.description: Only paths below a storage root may be written to. Categories reference a root and add a relative folder to it.
root.name_description: Shown wherever a target folder is picked.
root.path_description: Must be an absolute path that the service can write to.
root.default_description: New categories start on this root. Only one root can be the default.
root.delete_description: Delete the storage root "{name}"? Files already downloaded stay on disk.
root.minimum_free_description: Downloads for this root stop below this value. Empty inherits the global threshold.
root.ephemeral_description: This path is inside the container's writable layer or on a memory-backed filesystem. Everything below it is deleted when the container is removed or recreated. Mount a Docker volume at this path, or point the root at one that is already mounted.
root.default_locked_hint: The default cannot be given up while this is the only storage root.

category.title: Categories
category.description: A category combines a storage root with a relative folder and the post-processing defaults for its packages.
category.name_description: Used in the LinkGrabber, the download list and the rules below.
category.root_description: The allowlisted root this category writes into.
category.path_description: Folder below the root. Must be relative and must not contain "..".
category.color_description: Marks packages of this category in the lists.
category.default_description: Applies whenever no rule matches. Only one category can be the default.
category.postprocess_level_description: Overrides the global level for packages in this category.
category.script_description: Runs after post-processing; inherits the global script when unset.
category.cleanup_override_description: Off: the global cleanup list applies. On: only the list below applies to this category.
category.cleanup_description: Files with these extensions (without the dot) are removed after unpacking.
category.cleanup_empty_hint: The list is empty: nothing is cleaned up in this category.
category.cleanup_inherit_hint: This category inherits the global cleanup extension list from the settings.
category.no_root_hint: Create a storage root first — a category always needs a root.
category.delete_description: Delete the category "{name}"? Its rules are deleted as well and finished packages lose the assignment.
category.upload_description: Overrides the global upload switch for this category.
category.upload_remote_description: Optional remote:path override; empty = the global target.
category.recursive_description: Extract nested archives for this category (inherit = global setting).
category.sfv_description: Verify .sfv checksums for this category (inherit = global setting).
category.safe_postproc_description: Do not unpack after a failed PAR2, SFV or RAR check.
category.delete_par2_description: Remove the recovery set after repair and extraction both succeeded.
category.plugin_steps_override_description: Off inherits the global list. On lets this category choose — including choosing none, which switches a globally enabled step off here.
category.plugin_steps_none_hint: No steps here: packages in this category run none, even if the global list has some.

rule.title: Category rules
rule.description: For every new link the enabled rules are checked in ascending priority; the first rule whose conditions all match wins. Empty fields are not checked at all. If no rule matches, the default category applies.
rule.name_description: Only for your overview — the name is not part of the matching.
rule.category_description: The category a matching link is assigned to.
rule.priority_description: Lower value is checked first. Ties are resolved arbitrarily, so keep the values distinct.
rule.source_description: Restricts the rule to links that arrived through this route.
rule.protocol_description: Compared with the URL scheme, case-insensitive and without "://".
rule.domain_description: Must equal the host of the link exactly — subdomains are not covered.
rule.extension_description: Extension of the file name without the dot.
rule.mime_description: Compared with the content type reported by the server.
rule.regex_description: Regular expression matched against the file name; an invalid pattern never matches.

regex_editor.title: Regex editor
regex_editor.description: Build and test the name pattern against sample file names.
regex_editor.clear_hint: Leave empty to remove the pattern from the rule.
regex_editor.unparseable_hint: This pattern is too complex for the visual editor. Edit it in the expert tab or rebuild it from scratch.
regex_editor.invalid_pattern: The pattern is not a valid regular expression.

rule.empty: Without a rule the default category applies.
rule.no_category_hint: Create a category first — a rule always needs a target.
rule.delete_description: Delete the rule "{name}"? Links already assigned keep their category.

hotfolder.title: NZB and torrent hotfolders
hotfolder.description: Processed files are moved from the inbox to "processed"; rejected files are kept with unchanged content under "failed".
hotfolder.name_description: Only used to tell your hotfolders apart.
hotfolder.path_description: Absolute path that is scanned for .nzb and .torrent files.
hotfolder.category_description: Assigned to every import from this folder; without it the rules and the default category decide.
hotfolder.mode_description: Whether NZB and torrent files wait for review in the LinkGrabber or go straight into the download list.
hotfolder.processed_description: Relative to the watched folder, must not contain "..".
hotfolder.failed_description: Relative to the watched folder; the file content stays unchanged.
hotfolder.recursive_description: Also watches folders below the watched folder.
hotfolder.restart_hint: Saving restarts the watcher for this folder automatically.
hotfolder.delete_description: Delete the hotfolder "{name}"? Files in the folder are kept.
hotfolder.poll_description: Seconds between two reconciliation passes over every watched folder (5–3600). Running watchers take the value right away.
